Changelog
=========

3.1.0 (2026-08-19)
------------------

- Added ``Pool.drain(timeout=...)`` to close idle connections before shutdown.
- ``Pool.stats()`` now reports ``waiting`` and ``in_use`` separately.
- Fixed a race in ``Pool.acquire()`` when the pool was resized during a wait
  (#412).
- Documentation: new page on running tidepool under uvloop.

3.0.2 (2026-06-30)
------------------

- Fixed a leak of one connection per failed health check (#398).
- Wheels for musllinux aarch64.

3.0.1 (2026-05-21)
------------------

- Fixed ``ImportError`` on Python 3.13 when the optional ``tidepool[otel]``
  extra was not installed (#381).

3.0.0 (2026-05-04)
------------------

- Added support for Python 3.13. Wheels are published for CPython 3.9 to 3.13.
- Dropped support for Python 3.8.
- Breaking: ``Pool.acquire()`` is now an async context manager only. The old
  ``await pool.acquire()`` form raises ``TypeError`` with a hint.
- Breaking: renamed ``max_idle`` to ``max_idle_s``.
- New ``on_connect`` hook.

2.9.0 (2026-01-12)
------------------

- Added experimental free-threaded build checks. Python 3.13 is not yet
  supported; see #350.
- ``Pool.close()`` waits for in-flight releases.

2.8.1 (2025-11-03)
------------------

- Fixed type hints for ``Pool.__aenter__``.

2.8.0 (2025-10-02)
------------------

- Added ``Pool.resize()``.
- Python 3.12 support.
content.title: Changelog — tidepool 3.1 documentation

parts: tidepool **3.0.0**, released on **2026-05-04**, was the first release to support Python 3.13. Its changelog entry says "Added support for Python 3.13", and the earlier 2.9.0 entry says 3.13 was not yet supported. 【9†source】

Fixed. `parse_amount` now removes thousands separators before it checks the amount pattern:

```python
text = text.replace(",", "")
if not _AMOUNT_RE.match(text):
```

The line goes after the parentheses check, so "(1,234.50)" also parses as -1234.50. All 14 tests pass (`pytest --cov in the sandbox`). The DeprecationWarning from `totals.py` was already there and is not related to this change.
Show me the final parse_amount function only.
